annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1197 imposing an International Procurement Instrument measure restricting the access of economic operators and medical devices originating in the People's Republic of China to the European Union public procurement market for medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1197 imposing an International Procurement Instrument measure restricting the access of economic operators and medical devices originating in the People's Republic of China to the European Union public procurement market for medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation under the International Procurement Instrument excluding Chinese economic operators from EU public procurement of medical devices valued at EUR 5 million or more, in response to China's discriminatory procurement practices. It is a trade measure with no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Excludes tenders from economic operators originating in China in EU medical device procurements worth at least EUR 5 million.
Applies to all EU contracting authorities and entities, covering CPV codes 33100000-1 to 33199000-1.
Successful tenderers must keep Chinese-origin devices to at most 50% of contract value under IPI Regulation Article 8.
Finds that China's 'Buy China' preferences and volume-based procurement seriously impair EU access.
Enters into force on the tenth day after publication in the Official Journal.
